title: BcContainerHelper – versions
summary: BcContainerHelper is a PowerShell module for managing Business Central containers. This post documents release notes for versions 6.1.18 through 5.0.4, covering fixes for PS7 remote session issues, Docker service readiness, test app dependencies, backup operations, NuGet package handling, compiler folder functionality, and numerous other improvements.
key_points: Disables PSSessions for BC v27-v28 by default due to PS7 remote session issues, with escape hatches available
Adds Docker service readiness polling (up to 120 seconds) before creating containers to prevent immediate failures
Fixes multiple Run-AlPipeline issues including test app dependency installation and publishing with useCompilerFolder
Adds NuGet caching improvements and performance optimizations for package downloading and resolution
Introduces support for online sandboxes and pre-installed Business Central instances in CI/CD pipelines

quotes.text: New-BcContainer: Wait for the Docker service to become ready (poll up to 120 seconds) instead of failing immediately.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes improved resilience when Docker daemon is still starting, particularly important for CI runners

quotes.text: Use Artifact Index by default when using Get-BcArtifactUrl
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates a major performance improvement by using indexed artifact resolution as the default method
